import urllib3
from urllib3.response import HTTPResponse
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from app import client


def test_retry_policy():
    retry = client.build_retry()
    assert isinstance(retry, Retry)
    assert retry.total == 3
    assert retry.status_forcelist == [502, 503, 504]
    assert "GET" in retry.allowed_methods
    assert "POST" not in retry.allowed_methods


def test_default_methods_include_get():
    methods = client.default_methods()
    assert "GET" in methods and "POST" not in methods


def test_manager_configuration():
    manager = client.build_manager()
    assert isinstance(manager, urllib3.PoolManager)
    assert manager.connection_pool_kw["maxsize"] == 2
    assert manager.connection_pool_kw["timeout"].connect_timeout == 2.0
    assert manager.connection_pool_kw["retries"].total == 3


def test_json_response_roundtrip():
    resp = client.json_response({"ok": True, "n": 3})
    assert isinstance(resp, HTTPResponse)
    assert resp.status == 200
    assert client.parse_json(resp) == {"ok": True, "n": 3}


def test_headers():
    resp = client.json_response({"a": 1})
    assert client.content_type(resp) == "application/json"
    assert client.header_map(resp)["x-request-id"] == "r-1"
    plain = client.fake_response(b"hi")
    assert client.content_type(plain) == "text/plain"
    assert client.parse_json(plain) is None


def test_split_url():
    assert client.split_url("http://example.com:8080/x") == {
        "scheme": "http", "host": "example.com", "port": 8080}


def test_should_retry():
    retry = client.build_retry()
    assert client.should_retry(retry, "GET", 503) is True
    assert client.should_retry(retry, "POST", 503) is False
